note: Transparent TOP-15 until the dataset has both label classes: a rule selects candidates at T, a weighted sum of z-scored export-features columns ranks them. A feature's contribution is its weight times its z-score.

search.note: BM25 and GigaChat cosine rank query relevance; the provisional weak-signal score influences ordering but cannot create an unrelated match.

candidates.note: Rules at snapshot T. Unknown maturity passes; a known stage above max_stage_rank does not.

score.note: z = (value - mean) / std over all candidates at T, clipped; a missing value contributes 0. Negative weights penalize.

signals.note: Weak-signal cards (lctrend signals-report, ranking.signals). The ranked pool is clustered by name vectors, one dossier per cluster goes to the model, which names the niche and writes the reasons; stage, trend, score and sources are computed by code. Score = stage points + trend points, as in the analyst table of September 2026.

trend.note: Dated documents in the last window_months against the window before; ratio uses add-one smoothing. fast needs min_fast_documents recent documents.

stages.note: maturity_stage_rank (graph.json) -> card stage. mass_adoption is not a weak signal (max_stage_rank).

backtest.note: TOP-K at T from data up to T; a technology grew when its dated documents in (T, T+H] exceed min_growth_ratio times those in (T-H, T].
